messages.subject: Dependencies: What does your package need? package::function()
messages.subject_clean: Dependencies: What does your package need? package::function()
messages.body_plain:
Hey all,

I apologize in advance if this is not the right forum for my question (let me know if you think I should publish this elsewhere). I'm reading the part on Dependencies: What does your package need? in Hadley's book on R packages. It says there that if I add a package dependency using import it does not mean that it will be attached along with your package, and that the best practice is to explicitly refer to external functions using the syntax package::function(). I know my question is silly but I don't understand the  package::function() part. Can someone please provide me an example of how to implement this in a code?

Any help will be greatly appreciated,

Ayala

messages.body_plain:
If you want to use the GET function from the httr package, then you can refer to it as httr::GET(...).
And of course you need to put httr in Imports in the DESCRIPTION file.

Gabor
